item.title: Canada will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
item.description:
📝 Trump had temporarily paused those tariffs earlier in the week, saying the two sides were close to signing a trade deal that was "very good" for both countries. "After Carney's announcement US trade representative Jamieson Greer said in a statement: "Tonight, Canada declined to finalise the trade deal under the terms agreed earlier this week. Negotiators were reportedly discussing a deal that would reduce US tariffs on Canadian steel and aluminium from 50% to 25%, and on Canadian autos from 25% to 15%.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgvyy4x2mvo
